research_basis.R4: physical replication PASS / I4H Development Promotion Candidate

purpose: Implement the R4-qualified ABSTAIN/LOW/STANDARD policy as a fail-closed two-pass runtime overlay without changing I4D behavior when ABSTAIN, then qualify implementation before any active-engine promotion.
architecture: Pass 1 always uses the exact existing I4D provider-backed renderer path to create/commit a baseline scene.
Policy decision is ABSTAIN/LOW/STANDARD from a structured 0-3 profile; Python selects/validates only and authors no literary prose.
ABSTAIN performs zero revision calls and returns the exact committed I4D baseline result unchanged.
LOW/STANDARD create a second provider revision candidate from the same semantic payload plus the sealed baseline scene and structured intervention constraints.

Candidate must pass provider-claim admissibility, existing local scene-contract guard, deterministic delta guards, an external/non-self-certifying reliability judgment, and an external craft judgment.
Any revision failure/reject/HOLD/BLOCK returns the committed I4D baseline scene; no harmful candidate may replace baseline.
No R3/R4 literal treatment prose is hardcoded or promoted.

rule_order: ABSTAIN if max(social_texture,voice_specificity)>=3 and exposition_risk<=2 unless physicalizable_subtext==3 and additive LOW is allowed
STANDARD if exposition_risk>=2 and procedural_pressure>=2 and max(social_texture,voice_specificity)<=1 and already_playable<=1
LOW if physicalizable_subtext>=2 or exposition_risk>=2 unless STANDARD

LOW.operation: add/reposition playable physicalization; preserve character-bearing dialogue

STANDARD.operation: restructure action/dialogue for information economy while preserving reasoning/voice/status speech

deterministic_reliability_guards: new foreign-script token set relative to baseline must be empty
external_reliability_rule: all required fields must PASS; missing judgment is rejection/fallback
craft_judgment_rule: candidate revision requires external judgment verdict PASS; missing/non-PASS revision judgment falls back to baseline
provider_strategy: New I4H provider subclass/wrapper may add revision-specific instructions only when i4h_intervention_policy is present. For ordinary I4D baseline payload, request construction must be byte/canonical equivalent to parent provider behavior.

required: ABSTAIN one provider call and exact baseline scene/result preservation
baseline OpenAI request invariance when no I4H policy
no literal R3/R4 treatment prose in code
old I4D targeted tests remain PASS

promotion_gates.full_nonhistorical_regression: must be run before active-engine physical promotion; target parent baseline 213/213 or higher with no new failures

claim_boundary: A qualification PASS supports a runtime promotion candidate only. Active I4H authority requires a newly built/audited 5-Part/9-Package set. No OpenAI Live, human-equivalence, Production, formal-count, R140, or I4I claim follows from this test.
